content.short: Saga is a Web3 scalability protocol for the automated deployment of dedicated blockspace.
content.description: Saga is a protocol for automatically provisioning application-specific blockchains. It rethinks how developers and end users interact with blockchains by combining shared security, innovations in validator orchestration, and an automated deployment pipeline. With Saga, launching a dedicated blockchain, or a Chainlet, is as easy as deploying a smart contract. The network is designed as a scalable layer for web3 infrastructure, enabling bespoke blockchains tailored to apps and services.
